description: Estimate Grand Exchange flip profit after the 2% RS3 sales tax for an item, by itemId or name. This is an ESTIMATE ONLY: guide prices lag the live market, buy limits and fill times are not modelled, and actual profit will differ. Pass buyPrice/sellPrice to model your own offers.

buyPrice.description: Buy price per item in coins. Defaults to the current market price.

itemId.description: Grand Exchange item ID (provide itemId or name)

name.description: Item name (provide itemId or name). Prefer lookup_item for fuzzy search.

sellPrice.description: Sell price per item in coins. Defaults to the current market price.

name: estimate_flip
title: Estimate Flip Profit
